description: Get real-time Solana KOL trades from 1,000+ tracked wallets. Each trade includes the token's market cap (USD) at the moment of trade — sourced from our in-memory price tracker, accurate to the millisecond, faster than Dexscreener spot. PRO+ adds size/age/strategy/winrate filters.

action.description: Filter by trade type: buy or sell

before.description: Cursor — ISO 8601 timestamp; returns trades strictly older than this. Pass next_before from the previous response for polling.

kol.description: Filter by specific KOL wallet address (base58)

min_kol_winrate.description: PRO+: minimum 7d winrate of the KOL (0-100)

min_sol.description: PRO+: minimum SOL size per trade

token_age_max_min.description: PRO+: max token age in minutes at time of trade

name: madeonsol_kol_feed
